objective: Chinese interactive browser experience for the existing two-concept JavaScript practice loop; local loopback HTTP only, no model API or outbound application requests.
requirements: Preserve all existing src/learning.mjs, src/cli.mjs and tests/learning.test.mjs bytes. Reuse learning.mjs on server; do not duplicate or change learning rules.

No dependencies or install. npm start runs node src/server.mjs. Server CLI supports --port <0..65535> and --data <progress-file>, defaults 4173 and project .data/progress.json. Bind 127.0.0.1 only. Ignore .data/ in .gitignore.
Export createLearningServer({progressFile}) returning a Node http.Server, without listening on import. Serve only public index.html/app.js/styles.css; refuse arbitrary filesystem access.
GET /api/state returns {progress,nextAction}. Missing file initializes the supported goal only; corrupt existing history returns non-2xx and is never silently reset.

POST /api/exposure accepts {conceptId}; POST /api/practice accepts {conceptId,answer,assisted}; return {progress,nextAction}. Call existing domain methods. Validate types and reject extra keys. Wrong or assisted answers do not advance.
POST /api/reset requires exactly {confirm:true}, explicitly creates a fresh progress. UI asks for confirmation. No other request can reset history.

Serialize writes and use temp-file + rename persistence. Handle malformed/oversized JSON and unknown route with non-2xx. Reject cross-origin browser mutation requests. No runtime code evaluation, exec or arbitrary paths from user input.

UI: high-quality Chinese warm-white/teal learning workspace; left navigation and two-step path, main explanation/code illustration/MDN source and practice card, progress and right-side history. Responsive on phone; no external fonts/CDN/images. Accessible labels, focus states and keyboard submit.

Show wrong/correct/assisted feedback distinctly, disable duplicate requests, explicit loading/error/retry and completion states. Viewing material alone never grants progress. Hint marks this answer assisted. Refresh restores server state. Explain that completion covers two exercises, not broad mastery.

Keep feedback visible after response; clear assistance when moving to next concept. Correct unaided parameter advances to return-values; correct unaided return completes. Provide restart controls with confirmation.

Add real HTTP tests for initialization/practice/assistance/refresh/reset/corruption, reject invalid input and path access. Do not modify existing immutable docs. Update README with browser launch steps.
No git operations, installs, outside-workspace access, credentials, network research or control-plane changes. All actual product writes must be performed by this dispatched Codex execution.
